sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Custom Tools - API Pricing & Providers
sources.snippet: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview Custom Tools is a variant of Gemini 3.1 Pro that improves tool selection behavior by preventing overuse of a general bash tool when more efficient third-party or user-defined functions are available. $2 per million input tokens, $12 per million output tokens. 1,048,576 token context window, maximum output of 65,536 tokens.
